earlier_scan.note: ISO code retired 2016 as non-existent language; no descriptive materials

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Omejes language' (redirects to 'Spurious languages' list: supposed extinct Arawakan languages of Venezuela and Colombia, codes retired 2016).
sources.note: Nothing; lists [ome] among spurious Arawakan codes retired for lack of evidence of existence.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2015. Change Request Number 2015-031: retire [ome] Omejes (adopted, effective 2016-01-15). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; documents that the language does not exist. p.2 sec.3(c): 'Alan Wares, in correspondence with Barbara Grimes (5/28/1971), stated that Omejes should be deleted as "non-existent.".. Mention of this language is missing from all the major sources on South American languages (Adelaar 2004, Campbell 1997, Dixon & Aikhenvald 1999, Loukotka 1968, Crevels 2007, Voegelin & Voegelin 1977). Hammarstrom (2015) cites two additional sources (Landaburu 2000, Ortiz 1965) for the non-attestation of Omejes.'

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record omej1234 'Omejes' (JSON export): category Bookkeeping, bookkeeping=true, iso_retirement reason 'non-existent', Glottolog's fullest description is only a wordlist with sole reference the ISO change request.
sources.note: Nothing; zero descriptive references (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology).
